image_description: A high-angle, low-light photograph showing a dense group of sea lions hauled out on a wooden dock or pier structure. The animals are piled closely together, exhibiting wet, sleek fur that reflects the artificial lighting. Several individuals are visible, with varying orientations; some heads are tucked in, while others are raised. The background consists of dark water and the slatted wooden planks of the pier.
